notes.notes:

ENJOY!

notes.title: NEW GAME RELEASE
notes.notes:
The Witches Pond - is a small game based in Bucharest, Romania where You play as a Journalist who investigates so-called paranormal places to reveal the truth that they are fake. Everything goes wrong this time when he meets them, and goes through some events that may or may not seem real...

This game creates the path for future big projects that are already in progress!!

Thank you for playing.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2698990/The_Witches_Pond/]NOW ON STEAM - THE WITCHES POND[/url]
